reviewNotes:
RetroFold turns iPhone Duo into a 90s handheld console. Closed, the cover display shows the cartridges: swipe and pick one. Unfolded, the inner display shows the game screen above the fold and the controls below; folding pauses the game. On an iPhone without a hinge, the whole console shows on screen: tap a cartridge on the shelf to play (Lunar Hinge uses the A button or the up arrow instead of folding).

Free download with a free 1-day trial, then one purchase. The trial is the non-consumable "1-day Trial" at 0 (com.padelup.retrofold.trial1), as guideline 3.1.1 allows for non-subscription apps: tap any cartridge (or Store in the toolbar) and press START on "Free for 1 day". Everything is unlocked for 24 hours; nothing renews or is charged. After that, RetroFold Pro (non-consumable, com.padelup.retrofold.pro) unlocks every cartridge, skin, sound pack and screen mode for good. Restore Purchases is on the same screen.

All games are original. No account, no ads, no network access, no data collection.
